info.title: Review Master API
info.description: Internal API for web and mobile clients. Not for external use.

get.description:
ActionItem CRUD + custom transition-status / add-note actions.

Three-layer Staff scope:
  - Layer 1 (selector): list_action_items filters Staff to SHOP-scope only.
  - Layer 2 (permission): BrandScopeGuard returns 403 for direct-id access
    to BRAND items by Staff.
  - Layer 3 (UI): hide brand controls in plan 13-06/07.

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: Which field to use when ordering the results.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results to return per page.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description:
* `SHOP` - Shop
* `BRAND` - Brand

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
* `TODO` - To Do
* `IN_PROGRESS` - In Progress
* `COMPLETE` - Complete
* `WONT_DO` - Won't Do

get.description: Return shops with active progress snapshots (for topbar indicator).

Team management API: list/create/update/destroy + disable/enable/resend/stats.

Scoped to the authenticated user's organisation via TenantScopedViewSet.
Only ORG_ADMIN users may access this viewset (IsOrgAdmin).

ActionItemList.description: List endpoint payload — excludes nested notes/source_review for tight query budget.

ActionItemRead.description: Detail endpoint payload — includes nested notes (oldest-first) and source_review.

ActionItemUpdate.description:
ACTN-07: Title, Priority, Due Date, Assignee are editable. Scope/Shop are NOT.

Omitting scope and shop from Meta.fields means PATCH/PUT silently ignores
them in the payload (DRF validates incoming data only against declared
fields).

ConnectionStatusEnum.description:
* `CONNECTED` - Connected
* `EXPIRED` - Connection Expired
* `ERROR` - Connection Error
* `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` - Quota Exceeded
* `NOT_CONNECTED` - Not Connected

NotificationTypeEnum.description:

* `new_action_item` - New Action Item
* `action_item_assigned` - Action Item Assigned
